headline: Rosmari-Marjoram brings new gas supply onstream
news: On 17 November 2026, Shell reported that Sarawak Shell Berhad had started production from the Rosmari and Marjoram fields, 220 km offshore Sarawak. The development includes a 207 km pipeline to a new Bintulu gas plant, where hydrogen sulphide is removed before gas is supplied to the PETRONAS LNG Complex. This is a reported production start; the release does not state an achieved daily production rate.
engineering: Practical engineering question: for a long sour-gas route linking offshore facilities to an onshore plant, how are inspection coverage, corrosion-monitoring locations and leak-response responsibilities justified across the interfaces? The accompanying readings offer general integrity and risk-assessment lessons; they do not assess Rosmari-Marjoram.

field.teaser: The Chevron Richmond fire illustrates why inspection coverage matters as much as inspection frequency. Individual components can deteriorate differently within the same piping circuit.

research.teaser: The authors present a quantitative risk assessment interface for fixed offshore oil and gas platforms.
